text: Zombie outbreak in the mall. 5 rules... to stay alive.
say: Zombie outbreak in the mall. Five rules... to stay alive.

text: Saturday, 8 PM. The mall is packed. Thousands of people inside.
say: Saturday, eight P.M. The mall is packed. Thousands of people inside.

text: Then someone screams near the entrance.
A man lunges at the guard. Then another one.
Within 10 seconds, everyone's running... straight for the main entrance.
say: Within ten seconds, everyone's running... straight for the main entrance.

text: The doors jam. People push, people go down.
And all that screaming... that's what they follow.
Rule number 1: don't follow the crowd.
say: Rule number one: don't follow the crowd.

text: Rule number 2: look for the fire exit, not the entrance.
say: Rule number two: look for the fire exit, not the entrance.

text: Rule number 3: stay quiet. They hunt by sound.
say: Rule number three: stay quiet. They hunt by sound.

text: Rule number 4: turn off your phone. In the dark... they hunt the light.
say: Rule number four: turn off your phone. In the dark... they hunt the light.

text: Rule number 5: the bitten... are not your friends anymore. No matter who they are.
